newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen losing steam after Friday jump.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen losing steam after Friday jump.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to lose steam or falling on Monday after Friday's 2.4 percent jump accompanied by low turnover and mixed buying and selling after price-fixing.
Analysts said a good sign for listed shares was that they had put the large public offerings of Bank Handlowy and KGHM Polska Miedz behind them.

On Saturday the treasury ministry set the strike price in KGHM's institutional offer of 14 million shares at 21 zlotys and on Sunday bids in that tranche were reduced 21.6 percent at a special bourse session.
On Monday the 16 million shares in the individual investor tranche will be allotted at a special bourse session.
